name: restaurant-order-manager
description: Full-stack restaurant order management app with React, Node.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace server && node scripts/test-api.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build --workspace server && node scripts/test-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:perf: npm run build --workspace server && node scripts/test-performance.mjs
